params.body:
The sm derivative (thumbnails, 400x400 max) kept the original's format: for blurred photos that is a 400x300 PNG for a 116px tile, five to ten times heavier than needed. Now sm is WebP like md.

Existing photos carry a media_version whose sm file in the bucket is PNG/JPG, so:
- VehicleImageService::SM_WEBP_SINCE (2026-09-12): a photo versioned before that gets its thumbnail through the app route (?sm&v=...), which builds the WebP on first request and stores it at the same versioned path. No 404 window. md is unaffected.
- stocklist:fotos-afgeleid --maat=sm regenerates one size for every photo that already has a version, newest first, skipping files that exist; repeat in batches (--tijd) until it reports 0 created.
- Once that run is complete on production, drop the SM_WEBP_SINCE check (one line) and every thumbnail goes straight to the bucket. Step added to CUTOVER.md under 2.

Tests: sm URLs now .webp; a new test pins the app-route bridge for older versions.
params.title: Thumbnails as WebP, with a bridge for existing photos
